items.q: What happened when Kim spelled M-I-D-A-M to a voice bot?
items.a: It confirmed **M-I-D-A-N**, then thanked her and greeted **Madam**. English-centric TTS plus an STT M/N miss. She was still generous. Humans do that too.

items.q: What made her ask for a person?
items.a: Unknown **account number**, slow spelling **A-X-4-5-1**, **barge-in**, no record, **please repeat** with no sign it tracked her model. That is the typical voice-AI pattern she wants to kill.

items.q: What standard does she say voice AI has to meet?
items.a: Human communication as **joint activity**: sounds and words both ways while both parties update a **mental model**. We evolved that. We expect it of bots. STT to LLM to TTS is not enough.

**Listen / speak** times **sounds, words, interaction, mental model**. Eight cells, **interdependent**, aligned on a **timeline**. Any missing cell can fail the call. Engineering terms already have slots on this map.

items.q: Why does chat-bot thinking break on the phone?
items.a: In chat you **see the history**. In voice the air vibration is **gone**. Only the user mental model remains. Asking again, talking over, or repeating a slot proves the bot is not holding the same leftover model.

items.q: What human repair does she contrast with please-repeat?
items.a: **Interactive clarification**. Humans confirm a distinguished sound or ask a narrower question. Repeat-the-same-slot after a cut-off is rude relative to that norm.

items.q: Which business KPIs does she treat as linguistic KPIs?
items.a: Frustration, **task failure**, **live-agent escalation**, abandoned calls, **silent failures**. Attend to the map and those drop. There is no one patch; the fix is in you and your system.

items.q: What should you do besides picking a better ASR?
items.a: Try **EVA-Bench** as an end-to-end diagnostic. **Learn linguistics. Hire linguists.** Ask if the system is ready for the user **next time**, and for **language change** in six months.
